# js: imports for JS/TS modules. Smoke-test the checker accepts a SNGL
# file that imports a TypeScript module and calls one of its exports.
sngl check app.sngl
stdout 'app.sngl: ok'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"

output { js { html } }

import lib "js:./lib"

func wrap(a float, b float) => lib.add(a, b)

component main {
    text(value=string(wrap(1, 2)))
}
-- lib/index.ts --
export function add(a: number, b: number): number {
    return a + b;
}
